brief:
Settlers assaulted residents of eastern Bethlehem in Wadi al-Sha'er, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred in the valley area, which has faced repeated confrontations between Palestinian communities and settler groups.

Details of injuries or the specific circumstances of the assault were not immediately available. The attack adds to a pattern of settler violence in the West Bank area.
title: Settlers attack Palestinians in eastern Bethlehem valley
